input: # Versions the translation render (alchemy/render.alc) writes, as alchemy
# runs it, each under a comment holding the tree it was given, and the
# value every reader reads from them. A prerelease or a build given as one
# string is split at its dots and each identifier checked as one in a list
# is, then written as the string was; it reads back as the list of its
# identifiers, a numeric prerelease identifier as a number. The render
# refuses, with TARGET_VALUE_UNREPRESENTABLE and before it writes
# anything, a string with an empty identifier ("a..b", ".a", "a.") or a
# prerelease identifier of digits with a leading zero ("01"), and a major,
# minor or patch of digits with a leading zero however many digits follow
# it ("099999999999999999"): strict.tsv holds versions of each of those
# shapes, which no reader accepts.
# {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"prerelease":"alpha.1"}
# {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"prerelease":"0.a.-.--.a-b"}
# {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"build":"001.0a.exp-sha.5114f85"}: a build identifier may begin with a zero
# {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"prerelease":"x.7.z.92","build":"01"}
# {"major":"10","minor":"0","patch":"20","prerelease":["rc",1]}: a major, minor or patch as a string of digits
# {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"prerelease":"","build":null}: neither is written, and each reads back as an empty list
